metadata.description: A personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: job-helper
plugins.description: AI-powered job search assistant for Indian professionals: parallel scouts browse high-signal job boards, GCC/startup careers pages, and sponsor-verified abroad platforms in your own Chrome session, keep only fresh low-competition postings, find recruiter/founder contacts and draft a personalized connection note + direct message per contact, draft referral requests, generate a tailored cover letter for top matches only, remember your profile permanently, and track applications.
